title: Add Roadmap Structure and Timeline to the local web UI
description: Integrate Roadmap into project navigation with Structure and Timeline modes, filters, bounded paging, shared ticket detail and deep links. Verify browser interactions and responsive layout.
why: Deliver the reviewed roadmap plan without regressions in existing project workflows.

acceptance.text: All statuses appear in Structure by default
Timeline groups completion rows by month and pages older history
Project changes and stale responses cannot show mixed data
Desktop and mobile browser checks pass

outcome.summary: Added Roadmap Structure and Timeline, bounded pages, filters, month groups, shared details and return-to-page navigation. Verified 1280px/320px layouts, nested collapse, provider filters, project isolation, empty views and visible stale-page restart using 2000 disposable tickets.
outcome.verifiedBy: Windows Node 24: npm run check 91 passed, 1 opt-in real-model test skipped; final roadmap tests 14/14; TypeScript declarations 0 diagnostics; browser verification at 1280x850 and 320x740; 2000-ticket benchmark warm timeline 22ms, structure 82ms.
